config.recipe_text:
discovery:
  # MQ uses its dedicated Funnelback + page-data provider. Unlike the generic
  # search provider, it preserves international fees, IELTS, duration and source
  # evidence in scrapy_result so domestic-default HTML is never re-extracted.
  expected_min_courses: 300
  always_sitemap_supplement: false
  skip_browser_discovery: true

extraction:
  fees:
    default_currency: AUD
    prefer_international: true
    prefer_annual_over_total: true
  course_name:
    strip_title_suffixes:
      - ' | Macquarie University'
      - ' - Macquarie University'
      - ' — Macquarie University'
  # Per-course pages are also CF-protected; use scrape.do render=true for extraction.
  scrape_do_render: true
  filters:
    domestic_only:
      enabled: false
    online_only:
      enabled: false
  staging:
    reject_if_missing:
      - course_name
    skip_degree_qualifier_check: true
    require_international_fee: false
